title: In-depth characterization of stem cell potency and genotoxicity for clinical-scaleCRISPR-Cas9 gene editing.
snippet: Translating CRISPR-Cas9-based homology-directed repair (HDR) strategies into clinical application remains a major challenge due to limited standardization, concerns over safety, and efficacy issues.
